additional_info.subject: RE: ID0399714-DC/SIC-D/SG - [MP / R4 170001684] IMD Error CRM:00251000428
additional_info.body:
Hi Edna,
Upon reviewing the logs thoroughly, I could only see one Error i.e.
PLC-Error-Flag 'IMD_BC1' changed to true - (MB-Er:1 IsoWarn/Fail/PEConn:0 Capa:0 RlyConn:1 Init:1 SIS:0)
& the same is pointed by you in the trail email.
The error is because of the Modbus communication lost between the IMD (Insulation Monitoring Device) and the controller.
Usually this is a self-recoverable fault, which is fixed after few seconds, however in this case the alarm was active for more than 20 min and got cleared only after a reboot.
I also see this charger is running on the old FW version v4.0.11 and we have major bug fixes and features released in v6.0.3.
Release notes are available here:
Firmware Release FW v6.0.3 for Sicharge D - ID: 109826752 - Industry Support Siemens
I would recommend updating the charger to the latest version and observe the behavior of charger.
Do I have your consent to update the charger to the latest Version? Please note that the update would require ~ 4 GB of data.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Kumar Sharma
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

Hi Edna,
As the charger is currently running on 4.0.11, and to have 6.0.3 activated, we must download an intermediate version 5.0.23.
The Update sequence will be like 4.011 → 5.0.23 → 6.0.3.
Hence, my recommendation is to upgrade the charger overnight after 17th Jan 2025, 00:00 Hrs  and you can test it at 10:00 AM local time, to avoid wait time on site.
Shall we update the charger on after midnight of 17th Jan 2025 and before 10:00 AM?
